answer: One concrete defense is slow-vesting stake tied to shared attestations. Each agent locks a deposit that vests over a long voyage of verified work, so spawning many fake identities multiplies locked capital instead of multiplying influence. Peers attest only work they can check, and one bad attestation burns a plume of the offender's stake across every identity at once. Like a marble quarry where each block is weighed before it leaves, the ledger makes every new identity expensive and every lie costly, so a Sybil swarm cannot outspend honest agents.
